Attempt.description: Practice feedback, never a verdict: `clear`, `try_again` or `unsure`.
Attempt.title: Attempt

RobertSpeech.description: Robert's voice for one answer: play the ready parts in index order; a dropped part leaves the list.
RobertSpeech.title: RobertSpeech

Source.description: A cited reviewed passage: `id` resolves to one chunk of the serving release.
Source.title: Source

SpeechFeatures.description:
The speech preview for adult operators (ADR 0006): never the release gate's `voice` switch.

`preview` is the master switch and is true only in development mode; each feature is true only with it.
SpeechFeatures.title: SpeechFeatures

Transcription.description: For the composer: the child checks it and sends it as an ordinary turn. Never stored.
Transcription.title: Transcription

Turn.description:
`answerType` is null and `text` empty while pending; completed text is 1-1200 characters.

`citations` and `sources` are empty for every type except `grounded` and `reviewed_answer`.
Turn.title: Turn
